payload_convention: payload_size_bytes defaults to packet_size_bytes; no protocol overhead is modeled
time_convention: SimPy time; t0=0; metrics cover [0,T); events exactly at the run_for stop boundary execute on a later continuation
lifetime_convention: sensor alive-to-dead transitions at energy debit time; FND=1st, HND=ceil(N_initial/2), LND=N_initial
reachability_convention: physical graph induced by alive sensors and all sinks; network lifetime is the first alive-sensor reachability ratio below 0.5 or the first state with no alive sensors; the ratio denominator remains the currently alive sensors
energy_feasibility_convention: read-only independent one-packet snapshot using current TX/RX energy and MHR/EMHR relay rules; not a guarantee of concurrent or future delivery; no idle/sensing energy is modeled
timeseries_snapshot_order: initial at t=0; periodic monitor after packet generators already scheduled at the same time; final after all events in [0,T)
